case_title: Deepak Gulati v. State of Haryana
neutral_facts: The accused enticed the victim, wrongfully confined her, and had sexual intercourse with her. The victim was 19 years old at the time of the incident and voluntarily left her home to get married to the accused. She willingly became intimate with the accused on multiple occasions and made no complaints. The victim proceeded with the accused to get married in court but was apprehended by the police. The prosecution alleged that the accused made a false promise of marriage, but the court found that the victim's consent was not obtained under a misconception of fact. The accused was initially convicted, but the conviction was set aside due to insufficient evidence of a false promise.
